examples.arabic: هو نصحني اشتري حته قميص حلو
examples.english: He advised me to buy a nice piece of shirt.
examples.transliteration: Howa nasahny eshtery hettet qamees helw.

examples.arabic: هو كان لابس قميص كحلي غامق وانا كنت لابس تيشيرت ملون
examples.english: He was wearing a dark navy blue shirt and I was wearing a colored tshirt.
examples.transliteration: howa kan labes amees kohli ghamek wa ana kont labes teshert melawen

examples.arabic: احمد قال للبياع انا عايز قميص جديد
examples.english: Ahmed said to the seller I want a new shirt.
examples.transliteration: ahmed aal lel bayaa ana ayez amees gedeed

examples.english: I went to the market to buy a shirt.
examples.transliteration: roht el sooq ashan eshtery amees

examples.arabic: امي اختارت لي قميص حلو اوي
examples.english: My mother chose a very nice shirt for me.
examples.transliteration: Omy ekhtaret ly amees helw awy.

examples.arabic: ابن عمي كان لابس قميص فاتح وقال انه بيحب الوان فاقعة
examples.english: My cousin was wearing a light shirt and said that he likes bright colors.
examples.transliteration: ebn ammy kaan labes amees fateh we aal enno beyheb alwaan faqaa
